frontend_code_fingerprints.scope: Complete served code block; not container digest attestation.

native_checks: Header unchanged; all five complete cell rows preserved as a permutation.
Final descending budget order is Delta, Beta, Gamma, Alpha, Empty; blank values sort last.
=15+5 formula and all other native user-entered values preserved.
Protected sheet is exactly unchanged in native readback and captured state.
Other Workspace content and unrelated provider collections unchanged; native basic filter removed.
browser_checks: Create a filter, apply >=20, exclude 40 and Closed, and verify narrowed value choices.
Search and cancel preserve saved criteria after mobile reload.
Filter sort, remove filter, then perform header-aware advanced range sort.
Desktop and 390px layouts inspected transiently; final order persists after reload.
limits: Bounded hosted operator check, not a scored candidate rollout or full provider parity.
Deployment plus served source-block fingerprints are not per-container digest attestation.
